levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

notes: «8-3» is the report number, not a link. «حدثنا أبي» gives the father as a bare relation.
«بإسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap the text marks (rule 8): unnamed.
«أبي عبد الله» is named inside the chain before «قال»: narrator; the Prophet's words after «قال» are the saying.
